subject: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE Gen7 core V1: adversarial harness reproduces generation, reacquire, receipt and lease gaps
body: Manager independently verified Primary Gen7 core V1 package checksums and reran its baseline harness PASS, then compiled an adversarial harness against the exact V1 Kotlin sources. Disposition: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / revise before READY_FOR_PRIMARY; architecture remains viable and this is not a rejection. Reproduced gaps: (1) generation advance does not change/carry a callback token, so PresentationHinge accepts a measurement after currentGeneration advances; (2) 40deg@0ms -> 50deg@20ms -> 40deg@240ms returns reacquiring=true and reversalDetected=true, with REVERSAL_GUARD winning over REACQUIRE; this corroborates the live reversal/reacquisition handoff; (3) receipt ledger accepts FIRST_USEFUL after AttemptOwner terminal unless an external invalidate happens first; (4) receipt timeNs may regress while stage/frame advance; (5) RefreshLease acquire silently overwrites an unreleased current lease and the old lease can no longer be released through the model; (6) trusted deliveryTime may regress while sourceTime increases; (7) cover->inner migration begin accepts INNER as outgoing. Also not yet implemented from directive: bounded acceleration/jerk, small-vs-large critically-damped reacquire correction, repeated 30-70 oscillation/prediction-disagreement guard triggers. Targeted lanes should falsify/fix their corresponding item; do not duplicate architecture. CI/PHYSICAL remain NOT_RUN for Gen7 V1. No production writes.
